_doc: Neck pitch-to-head cradle on the pitch servo case (Idle T-acpw7j): the cradle's rear plate (combined__neck_pitch_to_head_cradle, build_neck_head_connectors.py stage 3) lies on the XM335 pitch case's rear face (its -x case face, manifest +y) and is held by 4 screws into the case's M2 taps (connector_screws.json neck_pitch_to_head_cradle, XM335.case-x.1..4), driven from behind the case (neck_head:s008). Catalogue hardware only (owner 2026-11-22), no sleeves: the plate has plain clearance holes (hole_dia, ISO 273 medium M2), cut as 45 deg teardrops pointing up in the print direction (process up -z, manifest -z), flat at teardrop_flat_mm from the axis; each ISO 7380-1 M2 button head bears on an ISO 7089 M2 washer (washer) on the plate's rear face. Why a washer: a bare M2 button head (dk 3.5) on the 2.4 mm hole leaves a 0.55 mm ring of plastic under it, less than one 0.62 mm line of the 0.6 mm nozzle, 5.1 mm2 of bearing; the washer's 2.4 .. 5.0 mm ring is 15.1 mm2 (2.96 x, so 2.96 x lower contact pressure on the PAHT-CF at the same preload) and 1.3 mm wide (2.1 lines); the head bears on the washer's 2.2 .. 3.5 mm ring. The washer is the body's existing hw:M2-washer-2.2-5-x-0.3 line. Plate thickness (review rv-acpw7j): the case's M2 taps are DP2, 2.0 mm deep from the case face (drawing; on the mesh all four holes alike: a 0.2 mm mouth chamfer (seat_offset), a 1.6 mm bore 1.8 mm deep below it, then the drill cone to 2.48 mm; the definition's 18.6 mm at the through holes .2 / .4 is capped at the drawing's 2.0). The full thread of the screw must end tip_allowance_mm short of the tap bottom, so that a forgotten washer (-0.3), a thin print (-0.1 .. -0.2) or a long screw from the bag does not run the thread into the bought servo's plastic case before the plate is clamped: plate_t = L - point - (tap - tip_allowance_mm) - washer h for the shortest standard ISO 7380-1 M2 length L whose plate is at least plate_min_mm (common.pitch_case_joint): M2x4 leaves 1.5, M2x5 leaves 2.5. Engagement 1.5 mm of full thread below the mouth chamfer against the 2.0 mm reference; with the washer forgotten the full thread ends at the tap bottom (0.0 mm). Hand check at s008: with the washer and the plate on the screw, the thread stands out 2.2 mm past the plate's case face (L - washer - plate). minus_x_edge: the plate's -x end (x_mm) has corner_r_mm rounds on its two vertical corners instead of the 1.6 mm default (at 1.6 the round on a 2.2 .. 2.5 mm plate left 0.63 .. 0.91 mm of wall beside the hole); the end is not moved outward. Clearance to the neck collar (head_neck_collar round 4, main c41b52c37; another session's part, not changed here) over the whole neck pitch range -30 .. +35 deg in 0.5 deg steps and 0.1 deg over +20 .. +28, whole cradle, washers and screw heads against the whole collar, exact closest-point refine (T-acpw7j fix; the review rv-acpw7j sweep cropped the cradle to x <= -1 and missed the +x end): main's cradle 0.049 mm at +22.8 deg (bottom rear +x corner, x 8.0; 0.31 mm at x -4 at +25.9), the 2.5 mm plate before bottom_relief 0.039 mm at +22.8 (bottom rear -x corner, x -13.4); with bottom_relief 0.354 mm at +23.2 (bottom rear edge at x -7.9, between the lower case holes), under 0.5 mm only over +21.8 .. +26.6, both corners 0.48 mm or more. bottom_relief (cut after the 0.38 edge bevel; build_neck_head_connectors _plate_bottom_relief): a chamfer along the plate's bottom rear edge over its whole length, edge_chamfer_y_mm into the bottom face and edge_chamfer_z_mm up the rear face (its round reaches z 388.88 on the rear face as before, the washer seats start at 389.0), and one flat cut per bottom rear corner (corner_cuts: outward normal, depth_mm below the sharp corner (x end, plate rear face, z 388.5) along it; chosen from separating planes of the collar's swept surface in the head frame with 0.35 mm margin; the -x cut stays 0.37 mm clear of the lower -x washer, the +x cut ends at x 5.05 on the bottom rear edge, 7.8 mm from the nearest washer). 2.67 mm3 removed, all at z <= 389.24 and y >= 15.04. The strips out to x -14.6 / -15.4 were rejected against an older collar and are not re-measured. head_clear_mm: radial clearance of the washer kept free behind the plate.

washer.source: ISO 7089 M2: d1 2.2, d2 5.0, h 0.3 (the body's hw:M2-washer-2.2-5-x-0.3 line, robot/body/torso/build_torso_carriers.bom.yaml)
